actions.reason: K4_C0001 has a substantively interpretable biological identity: RNA shows coordinated OXPHOS and immune/inflammatory down-regulation (q 0.001) and WXS shows PBRM1-high/VHL-enriched/BAP1-depleted (q_global 6.11e-07). No candidate-specific confounder association survives correction (strongest nominal site q 0.117, manufacturer q 0.054). Membership representation is mixed/weak (CT negative, others weakly positive), but the relevant boundaries are positively supported: the K4_C0001-K4_C0002 structural pair shows within-side affinity 0.499 vs between 0.161 with ARI 0.781, and the K4_C0001-K4_C0004 pair shows within 0.486 vs between 0.171 with ARI 1.0, providing affirmative boundary evidence of independence. The K4_C0001-K4_C0004 union is single-cluster-dominated (candidate_k=1), which is merge-compatible, but the well-represented current boundary and distinct biology (K4_C0004 VHL-high/PBRM1-low vs K4_C0001 PBRM1-high/BAP1-depleted) do not support collapsing them. Internal-subdivision screen shows no dominant multi-cluster signal (k=1 eigengap 0.806).

K4_C0002 has a strong, coherent biological identity: RNA shows OXPHOS up-regulation (NES 2.788, q 0.001) with coordinated metabolic/biosynthetic programs, and WXS shows VHL depletion (OR 0.023, q_global 2.3e-07) with PBRM1 depletion (q_driver 0.027). Membership representation is consistently negative across all four modalities (silhouettes -0.024 to -0.075, negative fractions 0.52-0.90), and candidate-specific confounder associations survive correction (site V 0.428, CT manufacturer 0.353, kernel 0.387, scanner 0.374, slice thickness 0.174, z-spacing 0.180, all q<0.01), so measured acquisition/site factors remain plausible alternative explanations. However, the relevant boundary is positively supported: the K4_C0002-K4_C0003 structural pair shows within-side affinity 0.570 vs between 0.193 with ARI 0.846, and the K4_C0001-K4_C0002 pair shows within 0.499 vs between 0.161 with ARI 0.781, providing affirmative boundary evidence of independence. The K4_C0002-K4_C0003 union is two-cluster-dominated but aligned with the current two-way structure (ARI 0.846), consistent with preserving the boundary. Internal-subdivision screen shows no dominant multi-cluster signal (k=1 eigengap 0.900).

K4_C0003 has a strong, coherent biological identity: RNA shows immune/inflammatory up-regulation (allograft rejection NES 2.816, IFN gamma 2.410, IFN alpha 2.336, IL6/JAK/STAT3 2.327, all q 0.001), and WXS shows BAP1 enrichment (OR 26.7, q_global 0.0059). Membership representation is conflicting (CT/RNA weakly positive, WSI/WXS negative), and candidate-specific confounder associations survive correction (site V 0.443 q 0.009, slice thickness q 0.034, z-spacing q 0.011), so measured site/acquisition factors remain plausible alternative explanations. However, the relevant boundaries are positively supported: the K4_C0002-K4_C0003 structural pair shows within 0.570 vs between 0.193 with ARI 0.846, and the K4_C0003-K4_C0004 pair shows within 0.633 vs between 0.164 with ARI 0.879, providing affirmative boundary evidence of independence. The K4_C0003-K4_C0004 union is two-cluster-dominated and aligned with the current two-way structure (ARI 0.879). Internal-subdivision screen shows no dominant multi-cluster signal (k=1 eigengap 0.889).

K4_C0004 has an interpretable biological identity: RNA shows UV response down (NES 2.008), Hedgehog (1.948), mitotic spindle (1.883), EMT (1.542), TGF-beta (1.450) up-regulation with OXPHOS down-regulation (q 0.001), and WXS shows VHL enrichment (OR 12.5, q_driver 0.022) with PBRM1 depletion (q_driver 0.022). No candidate-specific confounder association survives correction (strongest nominal CT phase q 0.252), though small set size (n=13) limits power. Membership representation is conflicting (strong positive WXS 0.811, weakly positive CT, negative RNA/WSI), but the relevant boundaries are positively supported: the K4_C0003-K4_C0004 structural pair shows within 0.633 vs between 0.164 with ARI 0.879, and the K4_C0001-K4_C0004 pair shows within 0.486 vs between 0.171 with ARI 1.0, providing affirmative boundary evidence of independence. The K4_C0001-K4_C0004 union is single-cluster-dominated (candidate_k=1), which is merge-compatible, but the well-represented current boundary and distinct biology (VHL-high/PBRM1-low vs K4_C0001 PBRM1-high/BAP1-depleted) do not support collapsing them. Internal-subdivision screen shows no dominant multi-cluster signal (k=1 eigengap 0.996) and no feasible k>=2 solutions.
